title: Harmony East w/rooftop patio
description:
Welcome to Harmony East — the perfect spot for your next stay in Music City! Located in trendy East Nashville, the space boasts vibrant interiors, luxurious finishings, a sunny rooftop patio and countless amenities, all within a quick 10-minute ride of Downtown. Just a few blocks away, you can explore East Nashville’s fantastic restaurants, cocktail bars, coffee shops and vintage stores. At Harmony East, we have it all. Happy Hour starts now!

The space
Harmony East is a 3 story townhome in East Nashville.  On the first floor includes a bedroom with 2 full beds and a full private bathroom as well as the laundry room.  The second floor is the main living space with a full kitchen with breakfast bar, a living room with a Queen size sofabed, a half bath and the master suite. 
The third floor is where you will find the rooftop patio and a small bar area.

Guest access
Guests will have private access to the entire space.
